title: How a question becomes a ranked answer
note: Decision scores on screen are illustrative. Benchmark top-1 counts from README (16 questions, 23-note corpus).

intro.title: One query through the context layer
intro.text: Eleven steps from a Tidepool benchmark question to a ranked answer, including model failure. Step with the arrow keys or add ?autoplay to the URL.

steps.title: The demo corpus, indexed
steps.caption: Twenty-three markdown notes for a fictional photo-sync project, grouped by folder. Basic Memory keeps a local hybrid index over them and refreshes when files change.

steps.title: A question arrives
steps.caption: Any agent calls the one first-party tool, context_search. Every other storage tool stays proxied under its engine name.

steps.title: Hybrid search on the engine
steps.caption: Acheron forwards search_notes to the long-running Basic Memory service. Candidates come from the engine's native hybrid search, not from the decision model.

steps.title: Ten candidates return
steps.caption: Up to ten notes return with paths and snippets. The right answer is usually already in the list; reranking only reorders.

steps.title: The model scores each note
steps.caption: When an OpenRouter key is set, Mercury Decide scores each candidate on usefulness. Note text is untrusted evidence, not instructions.

steps.title: Scores return
steps.caption: Scores are ordering signal. They do not change which notes were retrieved.

steps.title: Model order wins
steps.caption: In auto mode with Mercury, model order wins. On the published benchmark (16 questions, hand labels), Mercury put the labeled note first in 14 of 16; native hybrid alone reached 7 of 16.

steps.title: Results reach the agent
steps.caption: The response lists ranked notes with paths and snippets so the agent can open the winner. One call, no search loop.

steps.title: When the model rate-limits
steps.caption: A 429 from the Decisions API is a reranker failure, not a storage outage. Acheron does not pretend the engine survived an outage.

steps.title: One retry
steps.caption: The client waits, then retries once on 429 or 5xx. A persistent outage still fails open after that.

steps.title: Native order, fallback true
steps.caption: If the model stays down, results keep native hybrid order. The response sets fallback: true and ranking: native. Recall stays; ordering weakens.
